name: デモザイクアーティファクト分析
description: 分析します color filter array demosaicing アーティファクト to verify camera origin and detect synthetic images.
mechanism: Real camera images exhibit specific demosaicing パターン from Bayer CFA interpolation. This method 分析する inter-channel 相関 パターン at pixel level を検出するために 不整合.
parameters: CFA パターン: RGGB, Interpolation: bilinear/AHD/VNG, Correlation window: 5×5, Analysis: cross-channel
source: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Demosaicing, ACM IHMMSec
useCase: Verifying camera sensor origin by checking CFA demosaicing traces画像内の

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Demosaicing, ACM IHMMSec

strengths:
• Strongly linked to physical sensor
• Difficult to forge convincingly
• Works にわたる camera brands
• 検出します both AI and spliced images
limitations:
• Not applicable to RAW images
• Some cameras use non-Bayer パターン
• Heavy post-processing may mask traces
• Requires sufficient spatial 解像度
